what: TJX runs off-price stores (T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, and TK Maxx abroad) that sell brand-name clothing and home goods at 20 to 60 percent below regular prices.
customers: Value-seeking shoppers in the US, Canada, Europe and Australia.
money: T.J. Maxx and Marshalls in the US
moat: A buying organisation of more than a thousand buyers that picks up excess branded stock cheaply, and a treasure-hunt experience that is hard to sell online.
risks: Less excess inventory available from brands
